channel.title: Booked: First Day In
channel.desc: In Mesa County, a man caught smuggling fentanyl into jail faces mounting charges, while a woman arrested for drinking and driving worries about her dogs. In Flagler, a 19-year-old risks prison after stealing $8,000 from his grandfather. In Virginia Beach, an Uber driver is arrested mid-ride for embezzlement, a moped thief breaks down in his cell, and a cook with a warrant might miss catering a 100-person party.
